content:
joni: Heads-up: customer reported duplicate billing after a streaming toolcall resumed. Looks like provisional P and final confirmation both applied on replay.
mark: Which codepath? Resume/reconnect?
rhea: Likely. We create provisional on stream start, and confirm on finalize. If reconnect replays suffix, we see a new provisional then finalize both.
joni: trace tr_2026_03_21_300. Confirmed both P1 and P2 for same token range.
mark: Short fix: accounting should dedupe on toolcall_id when present, and accounting should ignore confirm if key already finalized.
rhea: Router change too: strip forwarded `x-attribution` on internal resumes so ownership can't be spoofed.
billing-bot: Created BILL-910 for reconciliation.
joni: Can ops add a quick dashboard: "duplicate-confirm events" filterable by customer? Helps triage.
mark: I'll implement accounting dedupe PR (48h). rhea will add router sanitizer (tomorrow).
joni: thanks, please post follow-ups in BILL-910.
